autoUnlock.title: Auto-Unlock (Passwordless by default)
autoUnlock.enabledDesc: Enabled: Kinana unlocks automatically using the OS credential store ({{platform}}).
autoUnlock.disabledDesc: Disabled: You will be prompted for your master password every time you launch Kinana.
autoUnlock.keyringUnavailable: The system credential store ({{platform}}) is currently unavailable.
autoUnlock.keyringUnavailableHintDefault: Please make sure your desktop keyring service (gnome-keyring or kwallet) is running.
autoUnlock.warningEnabled: Notice: Your master passcode is stored locally in {{platform}}.
autoUnlock.warningDisabled: When Auto-Unlock is enabled, your master passcode is saved in {{platform}}.
autoUnlock.warningDetail: Any other application running under your current user account on this device could read that credential. If you prefer maximum isolation, keep Auto-Unlock disabled.
autoUnlock.savedPasswordLabel: Passcode currently saved in system credential store:
autoUnlock.disabledToast: Auto-Unlock disabled: You will be asked for your passcode every time you open Kinana.
autoUnlock.enabledToast: Auto-Unlock enabled: Kinana will unlock automatically on launch.

autoLock.title: Auto-Lock on Inactivity (Auto-Lock Timeout)
autoLock.description: Automatically locks the app to protect your data after a period of inactivity. It will not lock while you are typing in forms.

recoveryKey.description: Save this key in a safe place. It lets you recover the entire vault if you forget your passcode. It remains masked by default and can be revealed or copied securely.

resetVault.recoveryNoticeTitle: Lost both your password and recovery key?
resetVault.recoveryNoticeDesc: Starting a new vault does not recover your old password. It permanently discards the current local vault data on this device. We recommend trying your recovery key, Auto-Unlock, or a previous encrypted backup before proceeding.
resetVault.confirmWarning1: All accounts, cards, passwords, and data in this local vault will become permanently inaccessible.
resetVault.confirmWarning2: This action does not reset or recover your old password. It permanently deletes the current local vault files from this device so you can create a fresh empty vault.
resetVault.confirmRecommendation: If you have an encrypted backup file (.dat) or your recovery key, please cancel and try them first.
resetVault.typeResetPrompt: To confirm deletion and start fresh, type {{word}} below:
resetVault.resetSuccessDetail: The previous local vault has been removed. You can now create a brand new vault with a new master password and recovery key.
